question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the letter that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dbe0bc9642829cf94362329dc3989669e6c48a8809e2e4c9e4dfb4af68be34a.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Both the letters at the end of the line are opposite as per the positional value table.**

Let's check,

**(C - X)** → C is opposite to X. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4e992e9eb0c9033d7f24d9ec94202f8cb2f8295cafbef4b9e2cd273c831cf16.png] 

**(Q - J) **→ Q is opposite to J.

**(S - H)** → S is opposite to H.

Similarly,

**(G - ?)** → G is opposite to T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
